description: Phase 1 end-to-end: React Query persistence hooks over the FEAT-001 RPCs/tables, SVG charts + presentational components, and the app/ route files with Portfolio-tab entry wiring. Delivers the MVP user journey (overview -> scenario selection -> run -> results dashboard -> persisted history). Depends on FEAT-001 (DB) and FEAT-002 (engine/analysis/scenarios).
steps: Create src/features/stress-lab/data/rpc-schemas.ts: zod schemas validating the record_simulation return shape (and the stress_simulations row) at the trust boundary. Create src/features/stress-lab/data/use-stress-portfolio.ts joining usePortfolio() (src/features/portfolio/use-portfolio.ts) with held-symbol instrument metadata fetched via supabase.from('instruments').select('symbol,name,sector,type').in('symbol', symbols) (Explore pattern, no user id) into LabHolding[]; validate qty/values are integers with zod.
Create src/features/stress-lab/data/use-scenarios.ts (React Query read of stress_scenarios, no user id), use-simulation.ts (read one by id), and use-simulation-history.ts (list newest-first).

Create src/features/stress-lab/data/use-run-simulation.ts: a mutation calling supabase.rpc('record_simulation', { p_scenario_id, p_phase }) with NO user id; a mapStressError helper (pattern of mapPlaceOrderError in src/features/trading/use-place-order.ts) mapping not_authenticated|no_account|unknown_scenario|scenario_inactive to friendly teen copy with a generic fallback; on success invalidate the history and single-simulation query keys. Validate the returned row with rpc-schemas before use.

Create src/features/stress-lab/data/use-run-simulation.test.ts and an rpc-schemas parse/reject test, mocking the shared client per-test with jest.mock('../../lib/supabase', ...) (style of src/features/trading/use-place-order.test.ts).

Create pure chart geometry helpers (allocation donut arc angles, start-vs-simulated bar scaling) following src/features/trading/components/chart-geometry.ts, with colocated geometry *.test.ts, then thin react-native-svg renderers src/features/stress-lab/components/AllocationDonut.tsx, ConcentrationBar.tsx, StartVsSimulatedChart.tsx, plus SimulatedBadge.tsx (the reused 'SIMULATED' label).

Create the Phase-1 presentational components under src/features/stress-lab/components/: PortfolioOverview.tsx, HoldingsBreakdown.tsx, ScenarioCard.tsx, ScenarioPreviewSheet.tsx, ResultsSummary.tsx, AssetBreakdownTable.tsx (FR-22 columns: ticker, company, shares, original value, simulated % change, simulated $ change, simulated ending value; gain/loss shown with a non-color cue too), SectorExposure.tsx, RiskObservations.tsx, and a components/index.ts barrel. Reuse src/components/ui and useTheme(); enforce clear REAL-vs-SIMULATED visual separation and add student-friendly tooltips/plain-language for jargon (NFR-5).

Create route files: app/stress-lab/_layout.tsx (Stack, mirror app/settings/_layout.tsx), app/stress-lab/index.tsx (portfolio overview + 5 scenario cards; FR-9 empty state with a button routing to '/(tabs)/explore'; a prominent 'Stress Test My Portfolio' button DISABLED while the run mutation is pending and when there are no holdings — design-review NIT-2, no client UUID), and app/stress-lab/results/[simulationId].tsx (results dashboard read via useLocalSearchParams from 'expo-router'). Routes stay thin: navigation + loading/empty/error states via StateView, all logic in src/features/stress-lab.
Wire the entry point: add a 'Stress Lab' button to app/(tabs)/portfolio.tsx that calls router.push('/stress-lab'), following the existing 'View trade history' -> router.push('/history') button.
acceptance_criteria: `npm test -- src/features/stress-lab` passes including the data-hook and geometry tests.

A signed-in user with holdings can reach the lab from the Portfolio tab, see overview figures matching the Portfolio tab, pick a scenario, run it, and land on a results dashboard showing starting value, simulated value, $ and % change, per-asset table, sector exposure, and at least one holding-specific observation, all labelled SIMULATED and visually distinct from the real overview.
A user with zero holdings sees the FR-9 empty state with a working Explore button and cannot start a simulation.
The 'Stress Test My Portfolio' button is disabled while a run is pending; no expo-crypto import exists in src/features/stress-lab.
No new runtime dependency is added to package.json; charts use react-native-svg.
findings:
DONE. FEAT-003 implemented in the worktree under src/features/stress-lab/{data,components} + app/stress-lab/. Verification green: `npm test -- src/features/stress-lab` = 7 suites / 72 tests pass; `npx tsc --noEmit` clean; `npx expo lint` clean (0 errors, 0 warnings); `grep -r expo-crypto src/features/stress-lab` returns nothing (NIT-2 satisfied). No new runtime dependency added (package.json / package-lock.json unchanged); charts use react-native-svg (already present). Committed on branch feat/portfolio-stress-lab (commit 5ff6a2e, NOT pushed).

ONE PRE-EXISTING TEST TOUCHED: adding the /stress-lab root route made src/features/auth/auth-gate.test.ts's route-coverage preservation test fail (it asserts every root route in app/ classifies to the 'tabs' branch). Per the in-code instruction in src/features/auth/auth-gate.tsx ('Every new root-level signed-in route under app/ MUST be added here'), added `pathname.startsWith('/stress-lab')` to pathnameToBranch's tabs list. auth-gate suite now 428/428 pass. The two other failures seen in a single full `npm test` run were 5000ms-timeout flakes under load (explore-screen + the same auth-gate); all three suites pass in isolation.

=== ROUTE PATHS (app/, Expo Router) ===
- app/stress-lab/_layout.tsx — Stack (mirrors app/settings/_layout.tsx); registers 'index' and 'results/[simulationId]'.
- app/stress-lab/index.tsx — route '/stress-lab'. Portfolio overview + 5 scenario cards; FR-9 empty state with a 'Go to the market' button -> router.push('/(tabs)/explore'); opens ScenarioPreviewSheet; the sheet's 'Stress Test My Portfolio' button is DISABLED while run.isPending and when there are no holdings (NIT-2); on run success pushes '/stress-lab/results/<server id>'. No client UUID.
- app/stress-lab/results/[simulationId].tsx — route '/stress-lab/results/:simulationId'. Reads the param via useLocalSearchParams<{ simulationId: string }>; renders ResultsSummary, AssetBreakdownTable, SectorExposure, RiskObservations; 'Improve My Portfolio' -> router.push('/(tabs)/explore') (FR-8, does NOT modify the portfolio); 'Try another scenario' -> router.back().
- Entry point: app/(tabs)/portfolio.tsx gained a 'Stress Lab' secondary Button (router.push('/stress-lab')) after 'View trade history'.
- src/features/auth/auth-gate.tsx: '/stress-lab' added to the tabs branch in pathnameToBranch.

=== QUERY KEYS (src/features/stress-lab/data) ===
- STRESS_INSTRUMENTS_QUERY_KEY = ['stress-lab','instruments'] (base; the live key appends the sorted held-symbol array) — use-stress-portfolio.ts.
- SCENARIOS_QUERY_KEY = ['stress-lab','scenarios'] — use-scenarios.ts.
- simulationQueryKey(id) = ['stress-lab','simulation', id] — use-simulation.ts.
- SIMULATION_HISTORY_QUERY_KEY = ['stress-lab','history'] — use-simulation-history.ts.
- useRunSimulation invalidates SIMULATION_HISTORY_QUERY_KEY + simulationQueryKey(newId) on success (invalidateAfterRun(client, id)).
- Reuses PORTFOLIO_QUERY_KEY from src/features/portfolio/use-portfolio (via usePortfolio). NOTE prediction/reflection/challenge keys are NOT yet created — FEAT-004 should add e.g. ['stress-lab','prediction',simId] / ['stress-lab','reflection',simId] / ['stress-lab','challenges'] and invalidate them from save_prediction/save_reflection/upsert_challenge_progress mutations, mirroring the mapStressError + invalidate pattern in use-run-simulation.ts.

=== DATA HOOKS / HELPERS (barrel: src/features/stress-lab/data/index.ts) ===
- useStressPortfolio(enabled?) -> { data: StressPortfolio|undefined, isLoading, isError, refetch }. StressPortfolio = { cashCents, holdingsValueCents, totalValueCents, totalGainCents, totalGainBasisPoints, holdings: LabHolding[] }. Joins usePortfolio() with instruments(symbol,name,sector,type) for held symbols (no user id). qty/valueCents validated as integers with zod.
- useScenarios(enabled?) -> useQuery of LabScenario[] (active, sort_order asc). LabScenario = { id,name,description,cause,conditions,expectedImpacts,learningObjective,severity:ScenarioSeverity,sortOrder,hasRecovery }. Maps snake_case DB cols -> camelCase; hasRecovery detects assumptions.recovery (COVID only).
- useSimulation(id?, enabled?) -> useQuery of StressSimulation|null (maybeSingle; RLS-scoped, no user id). fetchSimulation(id), simulationQueryKey(id).
- useSimulationHistory(enabled?) -> useQuery of StressSimulation[] newest-first. fetchSimulationHistory().
- useRunSimulation() -> useMutation<StressSimulation, Error, RunSimulationInput>. RunSimulationInput = { scenarioId: string; phase?: 'shock'|'recovery' }. Calls supabase.rpc('record_simulation', { p_scenario_id, p_phase }) with NO user id; validates the row with parseStressSimulation; invalidates on success.
- mapStressError(error) -> friendly teen copy for codes not_authenticated|no_account|unknown_scenario|scenario_inactive|invalid_phase, generic fallback otherwise (pattern of mapPlaceOrderError). runSimulation(input) and invalidateAfterRun(client,id) exported pure for tests.
- rpc-schemas.ts: parseStressSimulation(unknown) -> StressSimulation (throws ZodError on bad shape). Exports stressSimulationSchema, assetResultSchema, holdingSnapshotSchema and types StressSimulation/AssetResult/HoldingSnapshot. StressSimulation fields are snake_case (id,user_id,scenario_id,phase,starting_value_cents,simulated_value_cents,change_cents,change_basis_points|null,cash_cents,holdings_snapshot[],assumptions_snapshot:unknown,asset_results[],created_at).
- map-simulation.ts: simulationResultFromRow(row: StressSimulation) -> engine SimulationResult (FEAT-002 camelCase), so analysis helpers + result components consume the server-authoritative persisted numbers (no re-run of simulate()).

=== COMPONENT EXPORTS (barrel: src/features/stress-lab/components/index.ts) — PascalCase files ===
- PortfolioOverview({ portfolio: StressPortfolio }) — REAL overview card ('Paper money', NO SIMULATED badge): total value, cash, holdings/sector counts, performance, AllocationDonut by holding, ConcentrationBar + per-sector shares, InfoTip jargon help.
- HoldingsBreakdown({ holdings: readonly LabHolding[] }) — real holdings list (returns null when empty).
- ScenarioCard({ scenario: LabScenario, onPress }) — distinct card w/ name, description, SeverityBadge.
- ScenarioPreviewSheet({ scenario: LabScenario|null, onRun, onClose, isRunning, canRun }) — Modal preview; primary 'Stress Test My Portfolio' Button disabled when !canRun || isRunning.
- ResultsSummary({ result: SimulationResult, scenarioName: string }) — SIMULATED headline + StartVsSimulatedChart.
- AssetBreakdownTable({ holdings: readonly SimulatedHolding[] }) — FR-22 columns (ticker, company, shares, original value, simulated % change, simulated $ change, simulated ending value); gain/loss carries a non-colour glyph cue (▲/▼/–) + signed figures. SIMULATED badge.
- SectorExposure({ result: SimulationResult }) — uses analyzeSectorExposure; most-exposed/worst/best callouts + per-sector rows; InfoTip; SIMULATED badge.
- RiskObservations({ result: SimulationResult }) — deriveObservations rendered with tone glyphs; ends with the 'these are things to think about, not instructions' nudge (FR-8). SIMULATED badge.
- Charts: AllocationDonut({ slices: AllocationSlice[], size?, accessibilityLabel? }) (AllocationSlice = { label, valueCents, basisPoints }); ConcentrationBar({ label, basisPoints, warn?, height? }); StartVsSimulatedChart({ startingValueCents, simulatedValueCents, height? }). All thin react-native-svg renderers over the pure components/chart-geometry.ts (donutArcs, donutArcPath, pointOnCircle, comparisonBars, fillWidth — colocated chart-geometry.test.ts).
- SimulatedBadge({ label? }) — the reused 'SIMULATED' pill (FR-19). SeverityBadge({ severity }). InfoTip({ label, text }) — Modal popover for plain-language jargon (NFR-5).
- Internal (not re-exported): components/palette.ts (paletteColor), components/format-share.ts (formatShare: unsigned share%, since lib/money formatPercent is for SIGNED change).

=== NOTES FOR FEAT-004 ===
- REAL vs SIMULATED separation: the overview carries a 'Paper money · your real portfolio' tag and no badge; every simulated card carries <SimulatedBadge/>. Keep any new prediction/reflection UI consistent.
- Scenario shock tables are NOT fetched for display (only server computes authoritative results); LabScenario intentionally omits the numeric tables. FEAT-002 SCENARIOS/getScenario(id) remain the client mirror if ever needed.
- Money stays integer cents via src/lib/money.ts; use formatShare for allocation/exposure proportions (unsigned) and formatPercent/formatSignedCents for signed change.
- Mutation/test convention: per-test jest.mock('../../../lib/supabase', () => ({ supabase: { rpc: jest.fn() } })); see data/use-run-simulation.test.ts and data/rpc-schemas.test.ts.
